column1: # *** MARIA LLERENA, 60, ESPANOLA - HEAD OF HER OWN HOUSE. 20 September 2026. ***
# The second of the three Llerenas in 'Uruguay, Census Records, 1726-1858'.
# *** The page is rotated 90 degrees and is faint pencil *** - rotate(-90deg) with contrast(1.5).
*** SHE IS THE FIRST NAME ON THE PAGE ***
column2: *** 'Casa 2. Maria Llerena - 60 anos - Espanola'. *** The columns are *** name, age, nationality ***, and she stands at the head of her own household.
column3: *** SECURE. *** Found only after scanning the column end to end and then going back ABOVE the starting point - *** she was above it the whole time. ***

column2: *** MANUEL, 20, 'Africana' *** and *** ROSA, 12, 'Oriental' ***, both entered with a ditto mark where a surname would go.
column3: *** THE NAMES AND AGES ARE SECURE; WHAT THEY WERE TO HER IS NOT. *** 'Africana' means African-born, and *** in a Montevidean house of this period that ordinarily means an enslaved or formerly enslaved person ***, taking the householder's surname. *** The page states no relationship and none is asserted *** - but it is the same shape as Sancho's household in 1812, and this archive now names those four.

column1: *** WHAT MAKES HER WORTH THE ROW ***
column2: *** A Spanish-born LLERENA woman of sixty, keeping her own house in Montevideo. ***
column3: *** Sancho was ANDALUZ and 45 in 1812. *** Depending on this census's date she stands *** in his generation or the one above it ***, which is precisely the generation row 22 is stuck on. *** She is attached to him by nothing and is not claimed. ***

column1: *** AND THE DATE OF THIS CENSUS IS NOT ESTABLISHED ***
column2: The heading above her sits sideways at the top of the sheet and was not read; the collection spans *** 1726-1858 ***, and the index gives no year.
column3: *** WITHOUT THE YEAR, '60' MEANS NOTHING PRECISE. *** At an 1830s census she was born in the 1770s - Sancho's own decade. At an 1850s one, the 1790s. *** The single most useful next step on her is the date at the top of her own page ***, not another search.
